Requests 60 fps in normal Photo mode when the current preview stream supports it. Saved photos keep the original capture settings. Heat or an unsupported stream uses the camera defaults.
Adds Samsung-supported 120 fps recording choices to normal Video mode. Pro Video remains unchanged.

120 fps is limited to resolutions and lenses supported by the camera pipeline. This build targets rear FHD and UHD. 8K, HD, front cameras and special aspect ratios are not added without a supported recording path.
Uses Expert RAW’s native preview snapshot, blur and fade when changing lenses. If no snapshot arrives, the lens switch continues without waiting indefinitely.
Applies to lens changes. Existing front/rear and resolution animations keep their native behavior.
Camera Assistant and this app share the same switches. After changing Camera settings, force stop Camera and open it again to refresh its recording choices. Finish any recording or capture first.
Enable this module in Vector with Samsung Camera, Camera Assistant and Expert RAW selected. Force stop and reopen those apps after installing or updating the module.

Experimental support: Galaxy S26 Ultra (SM-S948Q), Android 17 / One UI 9 BZI9; Camera 17.0.00.43, Camera Assistant 5.0.00.7, Expert RAW 6.0.02.8. Other versions keep their original behavior. Requires an API 102 compatible framework.

Three confirmed crashes within two minutes after module operations stop changes in that app. Normal process restarts do not count. Reset protection and force stop/reopen the affected app to retry.
